project_type: Python robotics repo (ElRobot follower arm, normakit library) with MuJoCo/pybullet digital twins, FastAPI web console, and recorded real-robot sessions
build_system: none (plain Python, repo .venv); entry points are scripts/*.py
test_framework: pytest for webapp/tests (10 tests, conftest.py mocks anthropic client); scripts/selftest_sim.py is the end-to-end sim logic test
build_command: no build step; import check via .venv/bin/python -c 'import normakit' with sys.path including src/
verification_instructions: 1) .venv/bin/python scripts/selftest_sim.py must print ALL OK (exit 0). 2) .venv/bin/python -m pytest webapp/tests -q must pass 10 tests. 3) New scripts must run end-to-end headless and produce their artifact files. 4) Open produced PNGs and confirm they show the expected content.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/twin/* (PNGs, mp4, gif, replay_metrics.json) are generated artifacts that DO get committed for this task. presentation/videos/*.mp4 and run/recordings/ are local-only (gitignored / untracked) - never commit them. results/ is committed for small files.
setup_instructions: Nothing to install. Use the repo venv at .venv/bin/python (has mujoco 3.2.7, pybullet, opencv 4.13, PIL 10.4, numpy 2.2, fastapi/uvicorn/pytest). google-chrome is at /usr/bin/google-chrome for headless screenshots. ffmpeg is NOT installed; write mp4 with cv2.VideoWriter (mp4v fourcc) and GIF with PIL.
environment_constraints: Linux laptop, NO NVIDIA GPU (nvidia-smi fails), NO display (headless only). MuJoCo renders headless via MUJOCO_GL=egl (normakit.mujoco_backend sets this by default and imports torch first to avoid segfaults - construct MujocoBackend rather than mujoco.Renderer directly). pybullet SimBackend uses the tiny software renderer. Chrome headless needs --no-sandbox --disable-gpu (dbus errors in output are harmless). Never touch real robot hardware. Do not edit vendor/ or src/normakit/core.py safety limits (AGENTS.md rule). Team has UNCOMMITTED changes in the working tree - do not revert or commit them; add only files this task owns.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: document every change in CHANGELOG.md (newest-first; append a bullet under '## [Unreleased] - 2026-11-22' -> '### Added', end with ' - Claude'); document every problem in docs/ISSUES.md (label guesses as guesses). Keep replies terse. Never delete irreplaceable data. Docs pages are numbered docs/NN_NAME.md (latest is docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md, so this task writes docs/14_*.md).
key_patterns: MujocoBackend (src/normakit/mujoco_backend.py) mirrors StationBackend: state()/send_goals()/_sync(reg, {jid: bytes})/frame_jpeg()/reset_arm_ticks()/step_seconds()/set_cup_pose(). Raw servo ticks are 0..4096 per joint 1..8. scripts/validate_twin.py is the reference replay implementation: reset_arm_ticks(D[0]), set object poses, then loop: _sync(REG_GOAL_POS, ticks) + step_seconds(dt), tracking EE error vs normakit.kin.Kin FK. Recordings in run/recordings/<session>/ contain front.mp4 (8 fps, 640x480, cam0 = the calibrated front camera) and joints.jsonl (one line per video frame: {t, '1'..'8': {raw, norm, mA}}) - frame i aligns with joints line i. calibration/table_mujoco_front.json holds camera_pos_world_m and H_pixel_to_robot_xy_m (pixel on z=0 table plane -> robot xy metres). CHANGELOG bullets name files and measured numbers.
relevant_files: src/normakit/mujoco_backend.py (MujocoBackend; SCENE_XML constant; __init__ looks up black_cup/distractor_bottle/place_target bodies by name)
assets/mujoco/elrobot_scene.xml (calibrated arm+table+cup scene with front/wrist cameras)
scripts/build_mujoco_assets.py (how the scene and camera were generated; documents H and camera pose)
calibration/table_mujoco_front.json (H_pixel_to_robot_xy_m + camera_pos_world_m for the front camera)
calibration/camera_front.json (front lens intrinsics, 0.39 px reprojection residual)
run/pick1_frame_0000.jpg, run/pick1_frame_0300.jpg, run/pick1_frame_0700.jpg, run/pick1_frame_1000.jpg (extracted reference frames to look at)
docs/MUJOCO_TWIN_REPORT.md (prior twin validation numbers: 6.79 mm mean EE replay error on handover cup demo)
webapp/run.py, webapp/app.py, webapp/README.md (web console; .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend sim --port 8920)
webapp/tests/ (10 pytest tests; must keep passing)
scripts/selftest_sim.py (baseline sim test; must keep passing)
directory_structure: src/normakit/ (library: backends, kin, vision, agent), scripts/ (all runnable tools), assets/mujoco/ (MJCF scenes + hulls + table_tex.png), calibration/ (camera + table + servo calibration JSON), run/recordings/<session>/ (local synced front.mp4 + joints.jsonl), presentation/videos/ (local edited mp4s), webapp/ (FastAPI console: app.py run.py safety.py agent_bridge.py static/ tests/), docs/ (numbered design/report docs), results/ (committed benchmark outputs), handover/ (previous team's real-robot evidence incl. demo_traj_pick1.json cup demo)
